address: 55 Curzon Street, Mayfair, London, W1J 8PG, United Kingdom
bio: An opulent Georgian Townhouse whose décor takes its inspiration from early 20C Chinese interiors. Sit in one of the ground floor booths or in the brighter first floor 'Parlour'. The wide-ranging menu offers classic Chinese dishes; wood-fire roasted Peking Duck is the specialty and sharing is encouraged....
